newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Acerias Paz del Rio Q1 loss widens.
newsitem.headline: Acerias Paz del Rio Q1 loss widens.

text.p: Colombia's financially troubled steelmaker Acerias Paz del Rio extended its losses in the first quarter, the Securities Superintendency said.
It said Acerias posted a first quarter net loss of 10.8 billion pesos against a loss of 3.2 billion in the first quarter of last year.
The company, which is majority-owned by the Sindicato Antioqueno conglomerate, filed for bankruptcy last year, but the government recently pledged to lead efforts to prevent it from closing down.
The Securities Superintendency said its net assets as of March 31 totalled 337.9 billion pesos, up from assets of 321.6 billion pesos a year ago.
